stewardship.deescalation: Not applicable to antibiotics. If coagulopathy, encephalopathy, or worsening liver function develops, escalate urgently to a liver unit/transplant center for evaluation of acute liver failure rather than considering any antimicrobial intervention.
framework: Viral hepatitis does not respond to antibiotics - they provide no benefit and add unnecessary hepatotoxic drug burden in a patient with impaired hepatic metabolism.

Avoid unnecessary hepatotoxic medications (including some antibiotics, antiemetics in excess, and definitely alcohol) during the acute illness, since impaired hepatic clearance changes drug handling broadly.
Specifically counsel and monitor pregnant patients with suspected Hepatitis E given the disproportionately high risk of fulminant hepatic failure in this group.
